review.why: Writes and iterates ad copy for Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok within platform limits, grounded in reviews and winning ads.
review.summary: Four modes: generate from scratch, iterate from performance data, scaled static batches grounded in winning ads, reviews and comments, and a strategy loop that decides which ads to make. It lists character limits by platform, angle categories, hypotheses that can lose, an AI-tells blacklist, output formats and a review page for stakeholders.
strengths: Refuses to generate ungrounded concepts when the input corpus is empty
Test hypotheses must name the metric, the comparison and the direction
Checks every line against platform character limits
cautions: Very wide: static templates, video pipelines and vendor tools in thirteen reference files, none read here
Contains a promotional block for the author's own paid marketing agent
Performance pulls rely on command-line tools outside this skill
